recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit. If the work group wants to modernize or replace the tutorial example itself, handle that as a separate FHIR-I/extensibility tracker rather than as remaining FHIR-12441 work.
issue_request: FHIR-12441 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification Patient Administration change request asking that the Patient clinical trial extension not be defined around the US-specific NCT/ClinicalTrials.gov registry identifier. The accepted modification was to remove the extension because ResearchSubject had been approved, rather than remodel it with Identifier.
initial_application: Git commit 08d6684526b70e7455a1833ca8a98d848339bb74, titled 'Applied GF#12441 (Clinical Trial extension removed)', deleted the clinicalTrial, clinicalTrial.NCT, clinicalTrial.period, and clinicalTrial.reason rows from source/patient/patient-extensions-spreadsheet.xml. Current source no longer has an official hl7.org/fhir StructureDefinition/patient-clinicalTrial in Patient extension source.
additional_context: The only current patient-clinicalTrial occurrences are in source/extensibility-examples.html as an example.org complex-extension tutorial. Later Published trackers FHIR-18387 and FHIR-18391 deliberately revised that tutorial example by adding a note that most clinical-trial participation should use ResearchStudy/workflow-researchstudy and by correcting the reason example. ResearchSubject remains active in source/fhir.ini, and searches of the FHIR Extension Pack input did not find an official patient-clinicalTrial definition.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The removed core Patient extension is absent, and the residual tutorial example is explicitly example-only and non-canonical. Changing that tutorial under FHIR-12441 would exceed the seed issue's applied resolution and duplicate later FHIR-I context.

related_jiras.note: Published FHIR-I tracker that added the example-only note and ResearchStudy pointer to the remaining extensibility tutorial example.
Published FHIR-I tracker that corrected the same tutorial example's reason value, confirming later review of that example.
